description: Ron McCoy is an Independent candidate for WA State Senate, 7th District — a Navy veteran, former Mayor of Chewelah, and lifelong Northeast Washington resident focused on rural healthcare affordability, housing, veterans, and keeping communities alive without new local taxes.
